schema_defects_and_policy_gaps.title: Single status enum conflates polarity, temporal modality, and uncertainty
schema_defects_and_policy_gaps.assessment: Future negation cannot be represented cleanly as a structured combination in the supplied reported/planned/negative/uncertain enum. Choosing planned loses machine-readable negative polarity; choosing negative loses machine-readable future modality; choosing uncertain loses the underlying positive/negative and reported/planned dimensions. B11/B14 recover polarity only through qualifier prose. A13 uses uncertain for a boundary issue even though a planned cessation is explicit. This is a schema defect, not an enum syntax violation by either pass.
schema_defects_and_policy_gaps.consequence: A consumer treating every planned assertion as a positive appointment would misread B11/B14 valid_from as a CEO start. It must consult the negative qualifier until the schema is revised.

schema_defects_and_policy_gaps.title: One assertion status cannot encode reported service with a planned end separately
schema_defects_and_policy_gaps.assessment: The reported status coexists with a prospective valid_to. This is accurately explained in qualifiers but not structured at the boundary level. A downstream interval consumer may mistake a scheduled end for an observed outcome.
schema_defects_and_policy_gaps.suggestion: Record boundary modality/realization separately from current-role observation, while retaining original source assertions.

schema_defects_and_policy_gaps.title: Exact date or null loses partial precision and competing boundary interpretations
schema_defects_and_policy_gaps.assessment: Ruggeri CFO start year 2021 is known but an exact date is not. Null is correct under the required date schema; year precision is otherwise retained only in prose. For Donahoe the schema also cannot distinguish a literal date from a selected exclusive-day normalization or preserve structured alternatives.
schema_defects_and_policy_gaps.suggestion: Add date precision, literal date text, boundary meaning, and alternative interpretations without manufacturing YYYY-MM-DD dates.

schema_defects_and_policy_gaps.title: Assertion unit does not specify whether cessation is separate from an incumbent interval
schema_defects_and_policy_gaps.assessment: Pass B adds a negative filing cessation beyond its incumbent assertion; pass A does not. At the release, the passes choose different polarity/granularity. Raw assertion count differences therefore cannot be treated as recall errors without an explicit annotation-unit policy.
schema_defects_and_policy_gaps.suggestion: Specify whether explicit cessation is always a separate assertion and how complementary occupancy/cessation records are linked. Never derive a new positive interval from cessation alone.

schema_defects_and_policy_gaps.title: Organization aliases differ across all matched assertions
schema_defects_and_policy_gaps.assessment: A uses Starbucks Corporation and NIKE, Inc.; B uses Starbucks and Nike. The prompt does not mandate a subject label vocabulary. Source-local focal-organization normalization makes these equivalent without changing the raw files.
schema_defects_and_policy_gaps.suggestion: Use stable subject IDs plus the observed/canonical labels, and never carry a role between corporations.

schema_defects_and_policy_gaps.assessment: A06’s qualifier explicitly says its date conflicts with the filing’s August 12 date, but context_source_ids is empty. Its cessation/date evidence is still fully source-local, so the core assertion is supported. The separate ambiguity record correctly cites both sources.

schema_defects_and_policy_gaps.title: A13 positive-incumbent representation relies on cessation evidence
schema_defects_and_policy_gaps.assessment: The cited release text says he will retire from his role and later advise the company. This supports a planned cessation. An incumbent reading is pragmatically suggested, but no independently explicit positive service interval is supplied in the cited spans. C does not turn this into new positive occupancy. The filing’s explicit continuing-service statement belongs to a different source and must not be imported into the release assertion.
schema_defects_and_policy_gaps.suggestion: Retain A13 for audit and compare its boundary reading with B14 as an event-level interpretation only.

limitations: This is model-assisted reconciliation of two developmental machine extraction passes, not human adjudication or gold truth.
Neither pass pins a model revision or decoding settings. Separate conversational agents do not establish true model-family independence; no such independence or human IAA is claimed.
Only the four authorized local inputs were read for task data. No web, later sources, questions, expectations, gold annotations, predictions, or other project files informed C.
Four documents from two company announcements are a narrow pilot. Filing/exhibit repetition is related reporting, not independent corroboration of future realization.
Early cutoffs do not establish that announced future appointments or departures actually occurred. Scheduled boundaries remain planned.
Exact quote matches establish provenance accuracy, not completeness or semantic correctness of an extraction.
Ambiguous day normalization and source conflicts remain unresolved. C supplies no total timeline, new appointment dates, unsupported corrections, or invented positive occupancy.
Recommendations about schema and annotation units are proposals in this report; no existing prompt or raw output is modified.
